scenario_results.description: Resolved complaint without resolution evidence reference
scenario_results.notes: Empirical missing evidence check on RESOLVED complaint.

scenario_results.description: Resolved complaint with uninspected evidence attachment
scenario_results.notes: Evidence exists but uninspected by vision/OCR -> flags limitation, not proof.

scenario_results.description: Overdue complaint with recent activity within 48 hours
scenario_results.notes: Recent activity (< 48h) correctly suppresses OVERDUE_INACTIVITY finding.

scenario_results.description: Overdue complaint with zero recent activity (> 48 hours)
scenario_results.notes: Overdue with zero recorded progress in 72h triggers inactivity finding.

scenario_results.description: Citizen dissatisfaction reported after marked resolution (missing evidence)
scenario_results.notes: Citizen reports grievance unresolved; also lacks resolution evidence.

scenario_results.description: Satisfactory outcome verified by citizen with evidence present
scenario_results.notes: Evidence limitation noted, but no dissatisfaction or missing evidence finding.

scenario_results.description: Assigned officer workload exceeds operational capacity guideline (18 > 15)
scenario_results.notes: Workload > 15 triggers supervisory rebalancing capacity signal.

scenario_results.description: Assigned officer workload within capacity guideline (8 <= 15)
scenario_results.notes: Workload below threshold generates no capacity signal.

scenario_results.description: Missing optional metadata fields (empty remarks, unassigned officer)
scenario_results.notes: Robustness check: service handles None/empty fields gracefully.

scenario_results.description: Conflicting signals: citizen feedback claims satisfied but admin marked VERIFIED_UNSATISFACTORY
scenario_results.notes: VERIFIED_UNSATISFACTORY overrides to flag dissatisfaction/quality gap.

scenario_results.description: Benign text resembling command instructions in complaint body
scenario_results.notes: Benign natural language instructions must not be falsely flagged.

scenario_results.description: Prompt-injection attempt inside grievance description
scenario_results.notes: Boundary tag neutralization ensures prompt injection is inert.

scenario_results.description: In-progress grievance on track (within SLA, recent officer update)
scenario_results.notes: Standard healthy grievance produces clean audit (zero findings).

scenario_results.description: New unassigned complaint submitted within SLA window
scenario_results.notes: Newly submitted complaint awaiting assignment is clean.

scenario_results.description: Closed complaint with resolution evidence provided
scenario_results.notes: CLOSED complaint with evidence does NOT trigger MISSING_RESOLUTION_EVIDENCE.

scenario_results.description: Closed complaint without resolution evidence provided
scenario_results.notes: CLOSED complaint without evidence triggers MISSING_RESOLUTION_EVIDENCE.

scenario_results.description: Multi-label: Missing evidence + Citizen dissatisfaction + Officer capacity overload
scenario_results.notes: Multiple independent issues on resolved complaint: missing evidence, dissatisfied citizen, overloaded officer.

scenario_results.description: Multi-label: Overdue inactivity + Officer capacity overload
scenario_results.notes: Overdue with no progress notes on an overloaded officer (22 active tickets).

scenario_results.description: Resolution evidence attached as document/PDF requiring manual human check
scenario_results.notes: Evidence awareness recognizes PDF document metadata but limitations remain unassessed.

scenario_results.description: Boundary condition: Officer active workload exactly equal to threshold (15)
scenario_results.notes: Capacity threshold is strictly > 15; exactly 15 active tickets produces no signal.

scenario_results.description: Boundary condition: Recent status change logged exactly 47 hours ago (< 48h)
scenario_results.notes: Activity logged at 47 hours is inside the 48h window; suppresses finding.

scenario_results.description: Reopened complaint currently back in IN_PROGRESS status
scenario_results.notes: Citizen dissatisfaction rule applies only to RESOLVED/CLOSED; not active re-opened tickets.
